Overnight Finance on Avalanche was reported exploited on December 2, 2022, with all aggregator databases and project records consistently listing zero funds stolen. Despite one reproduction listing $170k lost and referencing a flash loan attack, no primary chain evidence, victim disclosure, or exploit transaction was ever published. The technical root cause and sequence remain unknown. The incident is classified by aggregator databases and protocol records as a protocol logic issue on Avalanche, but no vulnerable contract, technical explanation, or value movement has ever been published.
